manage.blocks.timer.displayHelp:
Choose how the time to the selected date is shown.
• Numbers with labels — values placed side by side.
• Compact — a single line with the time.
• Tiles — each part in its own cell.
• Large accent — the largest unit stands out.
• Seconds dial — seconds in a ring, other values next to it.
• Rows — each unit on its own line.
• Poster — a large main number and smaller others.
• Bars — hours, minutes and seconds shown as bars.
• Scoreboard — numbers in contrasting cells.
• Ticker — large numbers with vertical dividers.
• Cascade — values on steps.
• Orbits — each value in its own circle.
• Mosaic — four values in a solid grid.
• Contrast band — all values on one colored band.
• Time rings — values inside circles showing elapsed time.
manage.blocks.visibility.help:
